## Description

Before building any P8 feature: agreed adoption target, evidence review (customer demand, clinical evidence), regulatory classification review for any decision-support aspect, and a minor-version release-notes template.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Each P8 ticket links an approved intake record before work starts.
- [ ] **AC2.** Minor-version release notes template exists and is used.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
